Eat it to recover a lot of hearts.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasted Big Hearty Truffles are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are made when [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They have better nutrition and a greater aroma than a regular Big Hearty Truffle. Eating a Toasted Big Hearty Truffle restores four and a half [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasted Big Hearty Truffles reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can created by allowing [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s to come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They are known for both their aroma and their nutrition. By eating a Toasted Big Hearty Truffle, [[Link]] will heal four and a half [[Heart]]s in his [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Big Hearty Truffle * Food * Roasted Food * Toasted Hearty Truffle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
